ucs.title: [LLM] Akira (Howling Scorpius / GOLD SAHARA) — AnyDesk/RustDesk silent install followed by Advanced IP Scanner / SoftPerfect NetScan within 24h
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic Akira post-VPN-breach chain: after brute-forcing a VPN appliance without MFA (Cisco ASA, SonicWall CVE-2024-40766), the crew immediately deploys AnyDesk or RustDesk in silent/service mode for resilient C2, then runs SoftPerfect NetScanner or Advanced IP Scanner to map the internal estate before lateral movement.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) AS rmm_time values(Processes.process) AS rmm_cmd values(Processes.user) AS rmm_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","anydesk.exe") AND Processes.process="*--install*") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","anydesk.exe") AND Processes.process="*--silent*") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","anydesk.exe") AND Processes.process="*--start-with-win*") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("RustDesk.exe","rustdesk.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*--install*","*--service*"))) by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join dest [ | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) AS scan_time values(Processes.process) AS scan_cmd values(Processes.process_name) AS scan_file from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("advanced_ip_scanner.exe","advanced_port_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","NetScan.exe","NetScan64.exe") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` ] | where scan_time >= rmm_time AND (scan_time - rmm_time) <= 86400 | eval delay_min=round((scan_time-rmm_time)/60,1) | table rmm_time scan_time delay_min dest rmm_user rmm_cmd scan_file scan_cmd | sort 0 - rmm_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowHours = 24;
let RMM = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "AnyDesk.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--install","--silent","--start-with-win"))
         or (FileName in~ ("RustDesk.exe","rustdesk.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--install","--service"))
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project RMMTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, RMMAccount = AccountName,
              RMMFile = FileName, RMMCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              RMMParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let Scanner = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("advanced_ip_scanner.exe","advanced_port_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","NetScan.exe","NetScan64.exe")
    | project ScanTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              ScannerFile = FileName, ScannerCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
RMM
| join kind=inner Scanner on DeviceId
| where ScanTime between (RMMTime .. RMMTime + WindowHours * 1h)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ScanTime, RMMTime)   // 24h = Akira CISA AA24-109A dwell
| project RMMTime, ScanTime, DelayMin, DeviceName, RMMAccount, RMMParent, RMMFile, RMMCmd, ScannerFile, ScannerCmd
| order by RMMTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowHours = 24;
let RMM = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName has_any ("\\AnyDesk.exe","\\anydesk.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("--install","--silent","--start-with-win"))
         or (NewProcessName has_any ("\\RustDesk.exe","\\rustdesk.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("--install","--service"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project RMMTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RMMUser = SubjectUserName,
              RMMProcess = NewProcessName, RMMCmd = CommandLine,
              RMMParent = ParentProcessName;
let Scanner = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\advanced_ip_scanner.exe","\\advanced_port_scanner.exe","\\netscan.exe","\\NetScan.exe","\\NetScan64.exe")
    | project ScanTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              ScannerProcess = NewProcessName, ScannerCmd = CommandLine;
RMM
| join kind=inner Scanner on Computer
| where ScanTime between (RMMTime .. RMMTime + WindowHours * 1h)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ScanTime, RMMTime)
| project RMMTime, ScanTime, DelayMin, Computer, RMMUser, RMMParent, RMMProcess, RMMCmd, ScannerProcess, ScannerCmd
| order by RMMTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\RustDesk.exe OR *\\rustdesk.exe OR *\\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\\RUSTDESK.EXE) @CommandLine:(*--install* OR *--silent* OR *--service* OR *--start-with-win*) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|rustdesk)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(--install|--silent|--service|--start-with-win)/i
| rmm_time := @timestamp
| rmm_cmd := CommandLine
| rmm_image := ImageFileName
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(advanced_ip_scanner|advanced_port_scanner|netscan(64)?)\.exe$/i | scan_time := @timestamp | scan_cmd := CommandLine | scan_image := ImageFileName}, field=aid, include=[scan_time, scan_cmd, scan_image])
| test(scan_time >= rmm_time)
| delay_sec := scan_time - rmm_time
| test(delay_sec <= 86400000)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=collect([rmm_image, rmm_cmd, scan_image, scan_cmd, delay_sec]))
ucs.rationale: CISA advisory AA24-109A, Sophos, Arctic Wolf and Mandiant all document Akira's near-identical post-access workflow: VPN brute-force → silent AnyDesk install (or RustDesk on Linux/ESXi engagements since the Megazord variant) → SoftPerfect NetScanner / Advanced IP Scanner for AD enumeration before Mimikatz and lateral movement. The crew (also tracked as Howling Scorpius / GOLD SAHARA / PUNK SPIDER)

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira pre-encryption playbook — Veeamp credential dump + KillAV (PCHunter/PowerTool) + vssadmin shadow deletion on the same host within 60 m
ucs.description: Hunts the Akira pre-detonation sequence: looting Veeam Backup & Replication credentials with Veeamp.exe (CVE-2023-27532 PoC), terminating EDR/Veeam services with PCHunter or PowerTool kernel drivers, then deleting shadow copies via vssadmin / WMI before launching the Akira / Megazord binary. The combination is a signature Akira chain, NOT generic ransomware behaviour.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count AS hits dc(Processes.process_name) AS distinct_tools values(Processes.process_name) AS tools values(Processes.process) AS cmds min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*vssadmin.exe*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil*cl *" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil.exe*cl *" OR Processes.process="*Get-WmiObject*Win32_ShadowCopy*" OR Processes.process="*Win32_ShadowCopy*Delete*" OR Processes.process="*Stop-Service*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*net*stop*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamCredentials*" OR Processes.process_name IN ("PCHunter64.exe","PCHunter32.exe","PowerTool.exe","PowerTool64.exe","Veeamp.exe","veeamp.exe")) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval window_min=round((last_seen-first_seen)/60,1) | where distinct_tools >= 2 AND window_min <= 60 | sort 0 - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 60;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend Bucket = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vssadmin delete shadows","vssadmin.exe delete shadows",
        "Get-WmiObject Win32_ShadowCopy","Win32_ShadowCopy","wmic shadowcopy delete"),
        "InhibitRecovery",
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("wevtutil cl ","wevtutil.exe cl ","Clear-EventLog"),
        "LogClear",
    ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(net\s+stop\s+\"?Veeam|Stop-Service\s+-FileName\s+\"?Veeam)",
        "ServiceStopVeeam",
    FileName in~ ("PCHunter64.exe","PCHunter32.exe","PowerTool.exe","PowerTool64.exe"),
        "KillAV",
    FileName =~ "Veeamp.exe" or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeamp.exe","VeeamCredentials","Veeam.Backup.Common.dll"),
        "VeeamCredDump",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Bucket)
| summarize
    DistinctStages = dcount(Bucket),
    Stages = make_set(Bucket, 6),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
    SampleImages = make_set(FileName, 10),
    Hits = count()
    by DeviceName, AccountName
| extend WindowMin = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where DistinctStages >= 2 and WindowMin <= WindowMinutes   // Akira pre-detonation typically <30min end-to-end
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 60;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend Bucket = case(
    CommandLine has_any ("vssadmin delete shadows","vssadmin.exe delete shadows",
        "Get-WmiObject Win32_ShadowCopy","Win32_ShadowCopy","wmic shadowcopy delete"),
        "InhibitRecovery",
    CommandLine has_any ("wevtutil cl ","wevtutil.exe cl ","Clear-EventLog"),
        "LogClear",
    CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(net\s+stop\s+\"?Veeam|Stop-ServiceSid\s+-FileName\s+\"?Veeam)",
        "ServiceStopVeeam",
    NewProcessName has_any ("\\PCHunter64.exe","\\PCHunter32.exe","\\PowerTool.exe","\\PowerTool64.exe"),
        "KillAV",
    NewProcessName has "\\Veeamp.exe" or CommandLine has_any ("Veeamp.exe","VeeamCredentials","Veeam.Backup.Common.dll"),
        "VeeamCredDump",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Bucket)
| summarize
    DistinctStages = dcount(Bucket),
    Stages = make_set(Bucket, 6),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
    SampleImages = make_set(NewProcessName, 10),
    Hits = count()
    by Computer, SubjectUserName
| extend WindowMin = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where DistinctStages >= 2 and WindowMin <= WindowMinutes
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Ransomware Pre-Encryption Tooling (Veeamp / PCHunter / PowerTool)
id: 7e1a9c12-4f55-4a86-9d63-akira-veeamp-killav
status: experimental
description: Detects single-event execution of tools that are signature artefacts of Akira (Howling Scorpius / GOLD SAHARA) pre-encryption staging - Veeamp.exe for Veeam B&R credential extraction (CVE-2023-27532 PoC) and PCHunter/PowerTool for kernel-mode EDR termination.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/01/30/akira-again-the-ransomware-that-keeps-on-taking
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1003
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.001
  - g1024
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_killav:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\PCHunter64.exe'
      - '\PCHunter32.exe'
      - '\PowerTool.exe'
      - '\PowerTool64.exe'
  selection_veeamp_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\Veeamp.exe'
  selection_veeamp_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Veeamp.exe'
      - 'VeeamCredentials'
      - 'Veeam.Backup.Common.dll'
  filter_legit:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_killav or selection_veeamp_image or selection_veeamp_cmd) and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Veeam administrators using Veeamp.exe forensically (rare; typically only after a known incident)
  - IR teams running PCHunter for triage on already-compromised hosts
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\PCHunter64.exe OR *\\PCHunter32.exe OR *\\PowerTool.exe OR *\\PowerTool64.exe OR *\\Veeamp.exe OR *\\pchunter64.exe OR *\\pchunter32.exe OR *\\powertool.exe OR *\\powertool64.exe OR *\\veeamp.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"vssadmin delete shadows"* OR *"vssadmin.exe delete shadows"* OR *"Win32_ShadowCopy"* OR *"wevtutil cl "* OR *"wevtutil.exe cl "* OR *"net stop Veeam"* OR *"net stop \"Veeam"* OR *"Stop-Service -Name Veeam"* OR *Veeamp.exe* OR *VeeamCredentials* OR *Veeam.Backup.Common.dll*)) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
ucs.rationale: Veeamp.exe (the CVE-2023-27532 PoC that decrypts Veeam B&R MS-SQL creds) and PCHunter/PowerTool kernel-driver-based AV termination are documented Akira-specific tools in the CISA AA24-109A advisory, Sophos X-Ops reports, and Arctic Wolf Labs incident write-ups - they're notably absent from Conti/LockBit/BlackCat playbooks. Other ransomware crews delete shadows, but the Veeamp + PCHunter + vssadmin
